sourceExcerpt: Pea ʻi heʻene nofo ʻi he moʻunga ʻoe ʻOlive, ʻo hangatonu ki he falelotu lahi, naʻe fehuʻi fakafufū kiate ia ʻa Pita mo Semisi mo Sione mo ʻAnitelū, \add ʻo pehē! \add*
explanation: The official USFM at Mark 13:3 marks the same phrase with \add and includes one space before \add*. Its VPL TXT encloses that phrase in square brackets and retains the space before ]. The comparison removes only the separately pinned brackets and that one exact ASCII space; display text remains the original TXT.
